newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Time not yet right to sell Renault-stake - Volvo.
newsitem.headline: Time not yet right to sell Renault-stake - Volvo.

text.p: The time is not yet right for Volvo to sell its remaining 11.4 percent share stake in French car maker Renault, Volvo deputy chief executive officer Lennart Jeansson said on Wednesday.
Jeansson noted that the current share price of Renault was quite low at about 120 french francs compared with the price of 180 francs Volvo received when it sold part of its Renault holding.
"It is better then to wait because we have cash," he told journalists. "We don't think the right moment is just now."
In 1994, Volvo sold a stake in Renault for 4.7 billion crowns. The shareholding is a remnant of the two companies' failed alliance.
Asked about Volvo's remaining stake of 3.9 percent of the share capital in Pharmacia & Upjohn, Jeansson said:
"We will sell when we judge the price appropriate."
